script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be this state → retrieve-register-ability-conf with (arg).
Let ability be this state → get-ability-id-from-conf with (arg, v).
If ability is the id of the move labelled "virus" on executer, then executer uses ability with its cast time and then [v, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}]]}}].
Otherwise, executer uses ability with options v's 'abilityOptions'.
